sanitary--adj.def: Clean and healthy, or relating to public health.

voter--noun.def: A person who votes in an election.
voter--noun.ex: Every voter needs an identity card.

presenter--noun.def: A person who introduces a television or radio programme.

sociable--adj.def: Enjoying the company of other people.

alcoholism--noun.def: The medical condition of being unable to stop drinking.

flexibility--noun.def: The ability to bend, or to change to suit a situation.

narcissistic--adj.def: Far too interested in yourself and your appearance.

persistence--noun.def: The quality of continuing despite difficulty.

cardigan--noun.def: A knitted jacket that fastens at the front.

specify--verb.def: To state something clearly and exactly.

adverse--adj.def: Bad and likely to cause problems.

tablecloth--noun.def: A cloth spread over a table.

enroll--verb.def: To join a course or an organization officially.
enroll--verb.ex: She enrolled in a night class.

deceptive--adj.def: Making you believe something that is not true.

cornerstone--noun.def: The most important part that everything depends on.
cornerstone--noun.ex: Trust is the cornerstone of trade.

critically--adv.def: Very seriously, or in a way that judges carefully.

imprison--verb.ex: They imprisoned him for a year.

overlap--noun.def: A part shared by two things.
overlap--noun.ex: There is some overlap between the courses.

unforeseen--adj.def: Not expected and not planned for.

inhabit--verb.def: To live in a particular place.

implication--noun.def: A likely result, or something suggested indirectly.

prawn--noun.def: A sea animal like a large shrimp that is eaten.

loosely--adv.ex: The film is loosely based on fact.

conjunction--noun.def: A word such as and or but that joins parts of a sentence.

clerical--adj.def: Relating to office work such as keeping records.

cruelly--adv.def: In a way that causes pain on purpose.

outlive--verb.def: To live longer than someone else.

ph--noun.def: A measure of how acid or basic a liquid is.
ph--noun.ex: Test the ph of the soil.

delicately--adv.def: In a careful and gentle way.

corona--noun.def: The ring of light around the sun during an eclipse.
corona--noun.ex: The corona was visible for a minute.

showbiz--noun.def: The entertainment industry, in informal speech.

coherent--adj.def: Clear, logical and easy to follow.

socialize--verb.def: To spend time with people in a friendly way.

finely--adv.def: Into very small pieces, or in a delicate way.

reinforcement--noun.def: Extra strength or extra people added to help.

taunt--noun.def: A cruel remark meant to upset someone.

piracy--noun.def: Attacking ships to steal, or copying work illegally.

rhinoceros--noun.def: A large heavy animal with one or two horns.

illustrate--verb.def: To explain with examples, or to add pictures to a book.

papaya--noun.def: A sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh and black seeds.
papaya--noun.ex: She cut the papaya in half.

craftsman--noun.def: A person skilled at making things by hand.
craftsman--noun.ex: A local craftsman carved the door.

playmate--noun.def: A child that another child plays with.

integrate--verb.def: To combine things into one, or to join a society.

abolish--verb.def: To end a law or a system officially.

tanned--adj.def: Having skin made brown by the sun.
tanned--adj.ex: He came back tanned and rested.

thickness--noun.def: The distance between the two surfaces of something.
thickness--noun.ex: Check the thickness of the ice.

nomad--noun.def: A member of a group that moves from place to place.

masseur--noun.def: A man whose job is giving massages.
masseur--noun.ex: The masseur worked on his shoulder.

utilize--verb.def: To make practical use of something.
utilize--verb.ex: They utilize rainwater for the garden.

appreciative--adj.def: Showing that you are grateful or that you value something.

fondly--adv.def: In a way that shows affection.

hourly--adj.def: Happening once every hour, or paid by the hour.

programmer--noun.def: A person who writes computer programs.

mumble--noun.def: Speech that is too quiet and unclear to understand.

prose--noun.ex: Her prose is clear and simple.

pawnshop--noun.def: A shop that lends money for goods left there.
pawnshop--noun.ex: He sold the watch at a pawnshop.

economical--adj.def: Not using much money or fuel.

giveaway--noun.def: Something that reveals a secret, or a free gift.

accumulate--verb.def: To collect more and more of something over time.

punctuality--noun.def: The habit of arriving at exactly the right time.

organizer--noun.def: A person who plans and arranges an event.

hemp--noun.def: A plant whose strong fibres are used for rope.
hemp--noun.ex: The rope is made of hemp.

modification--noun.def: A small change made to improve something.

innate--adj.def: Present in a person from birth.
innate--adj.ex: She has an innate sense of rhythm.
innate--adj.exTr: Doğuştan gelen bir ritim duygusu var.

compress--noun.def: A cloth pressed on the body to reduce pain.
compress--noun.ex: Put a cold compress on it.

elemental--adj.def: Basic and powerful, like the forces of nature.
elemental--adj.ex: The storm had an elemental force.

suspiciously--adv.def: In a way that shows or causes distrust.

doubly--adv.def: Twice as much, or for two reasons.
doubly--adv.ex: That makes the loss doubly painful.
doubly--adv.exTr: Bu kaybı iki kat acı yapıyor.
